script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

Title: GAME CHANGERS

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - EARLY MORNING

*(JOSH, 17, a lanky, unassuming kid, enters the gym. He's carrying a basketball under his arm. The gym is empty except for one figure.)*

JOSH: (muttering to himself)
Alright, Coach Thompson, another early morning.

*(Coach THOMPSON, mid-50s, a wise, stern man, looks up as Josh enters. He's putting away equipment.)*

COACH THOMPSON:
You're early today, Josh.

JOSH:
Just wanted to work on some shots before school. You know, make the most of my time here.

*(Coach Thompson smiles and nods.)*

COACH THOMPSON:
I respect that, Josh. But first, let me get this equipment put away.

*(They work together to finish up. Coach Thompson hands Josh a basketball.)*

COACH THOMPSON:
Now, let's see what you've got.

*(They go to the hoop and start shooting hoops. Josh struggles at first, but with Coach Thompson's guidance, he begins to improve.)*

---

INT. HIGH SCHOOL CAFETERIA - DAY

*(Josh sits alone at a table, looking sad. A crowd of popular kids, led by QUINN, the star basketball player, gathers around him.)*

QUINN:
Hey, loser. What's wrong? Can't make the team?

*(Josh just looks away, not responding.)*

QUINN:
(laughs)
What? Afraid to answer? I know you've been trying out. You're not good enough.

*(Josh stands up, looking angry. But before he can react, Coach Thompson enters.)*

COACH THOMPSON:
Quinn, you need to leave Josh alone. He's here to learn and improve, not to be belittled.

*(Quinn and his friends leave, ashamed. Coach Thompson sits down next to Josh.)*

COACH THOMPSON:
You okay, Josh?

JOSH:
(sighs)
I guess so. It's just frustrating, you know? I've been trying to make the team for months, but I just don't seem to be getting any better.

COACH THOMPSON:
(smiling)
You're improving every day, Josh. It might not be as fast as you'd like, but progress takes time. And I believe in you.

---

EXT. HIGH SCHOOL FIELD - NIGHT

*(Josh and Coach Thompson are practicing under the moonlight. They're working on passing and footwork.)*

JOSH:
(exasperated)
I just don't get it, Coach. Why can't I be like Quinn? He's got all the talent and the confidence.

COACH THOMPSON:
(pausing)
Josh, everyone has their own path. Quinn might have natural talent, but he wouldn't be where he is without hard work and dedication. And neither would you. But you have something that Quinn doesn't – the drive to keep going, even when things get tough.

*(They continue practicing in silence as the stars twinkle above them.)*

---

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - LATE AFTERNOON

*(Josh is practicing alone when the door opens. It's EMMA, a new student, holding a basketball.)*

EMMA:
(smiling)
Hi, I'm Emma. I've heard about the great coach here. Mind if I join you?

*(Josh is surprised but nods eagerly.)*

---

EXT. HIGH SCHOOL FIELD - EVENING

*(Josh, Emma, and Coach Thompson are practicing together, passing the ball back and forth. They're having a great time and laughing as they improve their skills.)*

COACH THOMPSON:
(laughing)
You two make a great team!

JOSH:
(smiling)
I guess practice really does make perfect.

EMMA:
(grinning)
And we have the best coach!

---

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - NIGHT

*(The tryouts for the basketball team are in full swing. Josh, Emma, and several other students are giving their all, determined to make the team.)*

COACH THOMPSON:
(looking at the candidates)
Great effort from everyone today. I'll be making my decision soon.

*(Josh and Emma look at each other nervously, knowing their fate is in Coach Thompson's hands.)*

---

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - LATE NIGHT

*(Coach Thompson sits at his desk, going through the tryout results. He looks thoughtful as he reads through the lists of names.)*

---

EXT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - MORNING

*(The sun rises as Josh and Emma arrive at the gym. They're surprised to see Coach Thompson waiting for them.)*

COACH THOMPSON:
(smiling)
Congratulations, both of you. You've made the team!

*(Josh and Emma are thrilled, hugging each other in excitement. They've finally achieved their goal, and they know it's all thanks to their hard work and the guidance of their mentor, Coach Thompson.)*

---

THE END
